No. You already used the Option cards and activated their effects, so this card’s [Opponent’s Turn] effect can’t negate them.

Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this Digimon in play. During my turn, I use an Option card like [BT1-109 Smashed Potatoes] or [EX1-071 Win Rate: 60%!] which has an effect that activates “the next time one of your Digimon digivolves”. After that, all of my opponent’s Digimon become suspended. If I then digivolve one of my Digimon, are the effects from the Option cards I used earlier negated?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can. Activating  on Option cards that are already in your battle area doesn't count as using an Option card.
Card Q&A.q: My opponent has this Digimon in play. If I have an Option card with  that I used from my hand earlier, can I activate its  effect?

Effect: [Opponent's Turn] While all of your Digimon are suspended, your opponent can't use Option cards.
[Your Turn] When this Digimon becomes unsuspended during your unsuspend phase, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack.
